Name: Save Notes
Author: MniShark
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Save Notes 存档备注[/b][/size][/center]

[center]在存档选择界面为每个存档显示一段自定义备注，方便区分不同存档。[/center]
[center]Show a custom note next to each save in the load menu, so you can tell your saves apart at a glance.[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]功能 · Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]存档备注 · Save Notes[/b][/size]
在"加载游戏"界面的每个存档槽上居中显示一条自定义备注（深棕色文字）。备注写入存档文件夹内的 [i]SaveNotes.txt[/i]，与存档同生共死——重进游戏、移动存档、备份存档都不会丢。

Displays a custom note (dark brown text) centered on each save slot in the Load Game menu. The note is written to [i]SaveNotes.txt[/i] inside the save's own folder, so it lives and dies with the save — it survives game restarts, moving, and backups.

[size=4][b]铅笔编辑按钮 · Pencil Edit Button[/b][/size]
每个存档槽右下角有一个带铅笔图标的按钮，点击后可编辑备注。

A pencil-icon button appears at the bottom-right of each save slot. Click it to edit the note.
[line]

[size=5][b]使用方法 · Usage[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]打开游戏的"加载游戏"菜单。
Open the "Load" menu in-game.[/*]
[*]每个存档槽会显示备注（如果有）和铅笔按钮。
Each slot shows its note (if any) and a pencil button.[/*]
[*]点击铅笔按钮打开编辑面板。
Click the pencil button to open the editor.[/*]
[*]输入文字后按回车或点击"确定"。
Type your note, then press Enter or click OK.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]兼容性 · Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]适用于 Stardew Valley 1.6+ 和 SMAPI 4.0+。
Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]自绘 UI，不依赖任何游戏贴图，与 UI 美化模组（如 Overgrown Flowery Interface）兼容。
Self-drawn UI that doesn't rely on any game textures, compatible with UI retexture mods (e.g. Overgrown Flowery Interface).[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
备注改为按存档独立存储（Saves/<文件夹>/SaveNotes.txt），不再依赖模组配置。
Notes are now stored per-save (Saves/<folder>/SaveNotes.txt) instead of a mod config.
